details: @reaxuse/router@0.0.1 is a namespace-squat placeholder published under the reaxuse name (a React port of the @vueuse/router library). The package claims to provide router bindings but ships an empty stub: the sole source file has all exports commented out and contains only `export {}`, and the built dist/index.js is 0 bytes. No functional code, no dependencies, and no install hooks are present — the package exists only to occupy the @reaxuse/router name. Analysis is metadata-based; no network IOCs or executable payload were present in the tarball.
